headline: Portfolio Outperformance vs. SPY
summary: As of August 13, 2026, the portfolio is demonstrating a strong performance with an average return of 27.03%, significantly surpassing the SPY benchmark return of 14.64%. This results in an average alpha of 12.39%, indicating that the portfolio is not only gaining in absolute terms but is also effectively outperforming the benchmark. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has achieved an impressive return of 50.29%, contributing positively to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', still maintains a respectable return of 18.14%. Such outperformance against SPY is particularly noteworthy during times of market uncertainty, as it suggests resilience and effective management within the portfolio. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
